name: Tapstitch
summary: Fashion-first print-on-demand for brand-builders: premium heavyweight blanks (streetwear tees, oversized hoodies), bigger print areas and made-to-order apparel with no inventory — integrates with Shopify.
best_for: creators building a real apparel or streetwear brand who care about fabric, fit and how the product feels in hand
skip_if: you want the cheapest option or the widest catalogue — for pure margin and product breadth, traditional POD like Printify wins
honest_knock: Printify is cheaper, higher-margin and has a far bigger catalogue — if you're optimising for profit per sale or product breadth, that's the real trade-off. Tapstitch earns its place when garment quality and brand feel matter more than squeezing the last point of margin.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-12 on tapstitch.com/collections/all; the site publishes no /pricing page — that URL returns 404) No subscription, no monthly fee and no minimum order quantity — you pay per item, production plus shipping, so there is no plan price to compare. The all-products page lists 1,244 items, 48 to a page across 26 pages; in US dollars their 'from' prices run from $2.99 to $38.99, median $14.99, at fabric weights from 91 to 760 gsm. Every item carries the same quantity ladder: about 5% off the per-item price at 6-29 pieces, about 10% at 30-99 and about 20% at 100 or more, so the listed price is the one-to-five-piece rate. Visitors outside the US see the prices in their own currency (euros from the Netherlands). The honest catch is margin rather than fees. Printify's lower product and shipping costs mean noticeably higher profit per sale, while Tapstitch's heavyweight hooded pieces, at 345 gsm and up, start between $14.92 and $38.99. Price the finished garment against your retail price, not the platform.
